**Green. 625 pass, 0 fail.**

```
call:     orderTotal(12000, 15, 0.0825)
expected: 11042
actual:   11190
```

Fixed in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). Tax now hits the discounted amount.

Only rows with both a discount and a tax caught it. The rest hid it.

Next: nothing. Suite is clean.
